arm64.scope: Retained reset, substeps, post-loop filter, rider update, caller tail and actual original frame epilogue/ret 4; next frame recovery, player input, steering-rate and longitudinal burst setup, reset decision and terrain probes, engine entry and contact/reset paths and contact response through 0x4a6eac; AI/scripted paths stop before controller calls

initialStateChanges.thisMilestone: Source initial states, engine inputs and frame stack unchanged; subsequent reset RNG draws explicitly reuse the supplied initial CRT draw; exact repeated avoidance state is observed and unwound by the harness
initialStateChanges.trickCompletion: Additional cases initialize nonloop trick records and raw first-frame delta 1.2 before reset; inherited from the source input corpus and included in unchanged-prior-source checks here
initialStateChanges.frameInput: Initial analog enable 0/1; externally supplied axis values and device type before reset; no bike state reseeding at frame handoff
initialStateChanges.recoveryChoice: Initial bf8 set to 0/1; no handoff reseeding
initialStateChanges.balanceFilter: Initial value constrained to [0.25,0.75]; old arithmetic corpus includes invalid pose-domain values -0.1/1.1
initialStateChanges.control6f4: Initial values in [-1,1]; arbitrary old raw control words can drive animation blend out of range
initialStateChanges.animation: Complete linked pose/trick records and live objects initialized before reset; stopped and advancing rider objects
initialStateChanges.nearby: Inherited initial side-target scenarios from the source frame-rider corpus; no mid-loop state changes
initialStateChanges.nextFrame: Initial per-bike cap set to 1/2/4/10; next raw delta varied over +0/-0/1/120/.02/.04/.25/1; timing carry is retained without alteration
initialStateChanges.frameReturn: All eight combinations of disabled gate, scene state 2/3, and selected player initialized before execution

limitations: Synthetic initial state and animation assets; nonterminating original reset avoidance is captured at repeated state, not counted as a completed reset
Animation-start path with pre-existing flag820=1 not reached by this retained corpus
AI 0x46d240 and scripted 0x470560 controller calls not executed; explicit pending boundaries
Next-frame force, integration and collision stages not yet connected; rider visual object absent
At most four substeps in this corpus
Visual object c90 absent; static wall callbacks only
Long histories and whole-bike acceleration/release parity remain open
